       bash ca-certificates curl git libatomic1 make \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash runner
# End SECTION: base packages

# === SECTION: native mise bootstrap (managed) ===
# Source: template (clean-machine native mise provisioning)
# mise self-manages: the host installer only provides one mise binary, and
# `make setup` provisions the pinned github:jdx/mise release plus every tool
# from the committed mise.lock as the same unprivileged runtime user.
ARG RUNNER_USER=runner
ENV HOME=/home/${RUNNER_USER}
ENV XDG_DATA_HOME=${HOME}/.local/share \
    XDG_CACHE_HOME=${HOME}/.cache \
    XDG_STATE_HOME=${HOME}/.local/state
RUN curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh
ENV PATH="${XDG_DATA_HOME}/mise/shims:${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=.,target=/source,ro \
    cp -R /source/. /workspace/ \
    && chown -R runner:runner /workspace
COPY --from=git --chown=runner:runner . /workspace/.git/
USER runner
# Git metadata may arrive from a checkout or a committed bare snapshot.
# Bind its machine-local worktree path to this container; only the bare
# input needs an index and the files omitted by the Docker build context.
RUN metadata_bare="$(git --git-dir=/workspace/.git rev-parse --is-bare-repository)" \
    && git config --file /workspace/.git/config core.bare false \
    && git config --file /workspace/.git/config core.worktree /workspace \
    && if [ "$metadata_bare" = true ]; then \
         git read-tree HEAD \
         && git ls-files --deleted -z | git checkout-index -z --stdin; \
       fi
# End SECTION: native mise bootstrap

# Source: template (clean-machine bootstrap through the canonical verb)

# with nothing but the declared toolchain. It therefore runs the canonical
# setup verb fail-closed: any non-zero status fails the build. An earlier
# revision wrapped this in `set +e` and soft-passed whenever the output
# mentioned uv.lock/flext-core, which turned the proof into a bypass -- a
# broken bootstrap still produced a green image.
# The setup RUN receives GitHub's credential only through a BuildKit secret.
# Never persist build credentials in ARG, ENV, layers, or image configuration.
ENV CI=Y
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=github_token,env=GITHUB_TOKEN,required=true \
    make setup
# End SECTION: bootstrap proof

CMD ["make", "help"]

ENV XDG_DATA_HOME=${HOME}/.local/share \
    XDG_CACHE_HOME=${HOME}/.cache \
    XDG_STATE_HOME=${HOME}/.local/state
RUN curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh
ENV PATH="${XDG_DATA_HOME}/mise/shims:${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=.,target=/source,ro \
    cp -R /source/. /workspace/ \
    && chown -R runner:runner /workspace
COPY --from=git --chown=runner:runner . /workspace/.git/
USER runner
# Git metadata may arrive from a checkout or a committed bare snapshot.
# Bind its machine-local worktree path to this container; only the bare
# input needs an index and the files omitted by the Docker build context.
RUN metadata_bare="$(git --git-dir=/workspace/.git rev-parse --is-bare-repository)" \
    && git config --file /workspace/.git/config core.bare false \
    && git config --file /workspace/.git/config core.worktree /workspace \
    && if [ "$metadata_bare" = true ]; then \
         git read-tree HEAD \
         && git ls-files --deleted -z | git checkout-index -z --stdin; \
       fi
# End SECTION: native mise bootstrap

# === SECTION: bootstrap proof (managed) ===
# Source: template (clean-machine bootstrap through the canonical verb)
# The image exists to PROVE that a clean machine can bootstrap this project
# with nothing but the declared toolchain. It therefore runs the canonical
# setup verb fail-closed: any non-zero status fails the build. An earlier
# revision wrapped this in `set +e` and soft-passed whenever the output
# mentioned uv.lock/flext-core, which turned the proof into a bypass -- a
# broken bootstrap still produced a green image.
# The setup RUN receives GitHub's credential only through a BuildKit secret.
# Never persist build credentials in ARG, ENV, layers, or image configuration.
ENV CI=Y
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=github_token,env=GITHUB_TOKEN,required=true \
    make setup
# End SECTION: bootstrap proof

ENTRYPOINT []
CMD ["make", "help"]
' to NOT contain 'set +e'

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ qualify-setup            Attach elected native process observations to this setup                                    │

│ create-gate-attestation  Sign one original receipt as an immutable stage proof                                       │
│ verify-gate-attestation  Verify one signed stage proof against the live runtime                                      │
│ admit-gate-candidate     Admit an exact candidate against a signed stage proof                                       │
│ fleet-gaps               Report every declared repository's hygiene gaps (dirty paths, open PRs, unmerged branches,  │
│                          violation counts, standards presence) and publish the receipt                               │
│ tests                    Run native persistent incremental tests                                                     │
│ tests-full               Run the complete selected tests once and record them in Testmon                             │
│ tests-harness            Run only the harness gate tests under their harness                                         │
│ capture-gate             Execute the original checker once and publish its receipt                                   │
│ native-gate              Run one native command under the admitted gate budget                                       │
│ check                    Run every read-only validation of the check verb in one process                             │
│ identity                 Report canonical Git checkout identity                                                      │
│ editable-members         List declared members with authenticated installed editables                                │
│ flext-editable           Install and record setup's FLEXT editable selection; without --flext-root remove the        │
│                          receipt                                                                                     │
│ verify-environment       Verify live workspace editable provenance                                                   │
│ verify-lock              Verify the committed uv.lock carries every referenced package                               │
│ detect                   Detect workspace or standalone mode                                                         │
│ propagate                Publish this workspace's flext-infra to every member                                        │
